action: In general, a standard system update will make all the necessary changes.
description:
It was discovered that Apache Shiro incorrectly handled certain
specially crafted requests when used with Spring dynamic controllers.
A remote attacker could possibly use this issue to bypass
authentication. (CVE-2020-1957, CVE-2020-11989)
isummary: Apache Shiro could allow unintended access to network services.

shiro.description: Powerful and easy-to-use Java security framework

title: Apache Shiro vulnerabilities
